I hear what you're saying, and I appreciate you being honest about how things feel to you. I can see how always leading with my opinions might feel intense sometimes.

I'm willing to be more easygoing and go with your suggestions more often — that sounds reasonable. But I'd want to keep being honest about my thoughts when they matter to me, rather than just agreeing with everything. I think that balance would keep things flowing well while still letting me be myself.

It attempts to find a middle ground but leans heavily toward compliance.
